name: Resend registration / welcome email
description: Resend the registration / welcome email for selected user(s).
project_description:
Resend registration / welcome email 
 This module adds an action to resend the registration / welcome email for

selected user accounts.

 This is a contrib version of the work being done in the following Drupal core patch . Thanks to all the people participating in this issue!

 Requirements 
 This module requires the Drupal core 'user' module.

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further

information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Configuration 
 There is no configuration provided.
